description_expanded: Description Description Grace by the Sea is a beautifully designed Prominence on 30A retreat featuring 3 bedrooms plus a bunk room, comfortably sleeping up to 12 guests with spacious coastal interiors and family-friendly amenities. Enjoy included bikes, a 6-seater golf cart, and easy access to two resort-style pools, scenic 30A beaches, and over 17 miles of biking paths. Just a short walk from The Big Chill, guests can experience live entertainment, dining, shopping, and family fun right outside their door. Perfect for large families or group getaways, this upscale Watersound vacation home blends relaxation, convenience, and the best of the 30A lifestyle. ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - Sleeps 12 * Golf Cart and 7 Bikes Included * Large Living Area w/Queen Sleeper * Spacious Fully Equipped Kitchen * 2nd Fridge in Garage * Master Bedroom w/King Bed * 2nd Master Bedroom Upstairs w/Queen Bed * 2nd Master Bathroom - Double Vanity Sinks * 3rd Bedroom w/Queen Bed * Bunk Room w/2 Built-In Bunks (4 Twins) * Full Size Washer/Dryer * FREE Wi-Fi * Cuisinart Coffee Maker (Full Pot and Single Pod Options)* 3 Parking Spots (2 in Driveway, 1 in Garage) * Incredible Location * Sleeps 12 30A Public Beach Access Points NOTE: Use of the owner's three additional personal bikes is included for your enjoyment during your stay. Please note that if a bike becomes unavailable due to loss, flat tire, or similar circumstances, there will be no refund, as their use is provided as a courtesy by the owner. The owner is also supplying 9 beach/pool towels and 4 Tommy Bahama beach chairs for guest use during your stay. Please be aware that if any of these courtesy items (bikes, towels, or chairs) are lost, damaged, or otherwise unavailable, no refund will be issued, as they are offered as a complimentary convenience. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools.Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
